summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of non-independent Board member Juan Gonzalo Castaño Valderrama for personal and professional reasons, effective immediately after the May 12, 2026 board meeting. No terms, advisor, or recommendation are provided. The remaining board retains quorum and decision-making majority. This is a standard board resignation disclosure, not an activist campaign or strategic review. Watch for any subsequent replacement nomination or governance changes.
